museMessages.offline: Connection updates paused. Refresh to check the latest evidence.
museMessages.disconnected: Disconnected. These are the last observed connection checks. Detector cleanup and worker stop evidence remain separate.

museMessages.agentUnavailable: Connection checks passed. Resolve this agent’s setup or approval blocker before assigning tasks.

access.intro: Copy the connection instructions into your Bot’s chat. Add the custom MCP plugin and complete its browser authorization.
access.promptDescription: Send these instructions to your Bot. The pairing code stays in your browser.
access.pairingHint: Copy this code into Paperclip’s authorization page. Do not paste it into Bot chat. Expires {{time}}.
access.watching: Watching for authorization. This connection works as the named agent.
access.accountWide: Grok plugins are account-wide. Linking one Bot does not isolate its credentials from other Bots on your account.

routine.intro: Ask your Bot to create a webhook-only routine, then open its Webhook panel in the desktop app.
routine.promptDescription: Send this to the connected Bot. The routine wakes it when Paperclip work changes.
routine.clickHint: If clicking the routine does nothing, use the “Webhook URL” navigation link the Bot supplies.
routine.stored: Routine credentials are stored. Continue to verify both directions.
routine.copyFields: Copy these fields directly from Grok into Paperclip. Credentials are stored securely and are never included in instructions.

verify.recovery: Recovery needed. Inspect Grok’s activity in this agent’s configuration before another delivery.
verify.ready: Both directions verified. Your Bot is ready for tasks.
verify.finishing: Both directions verified. Paperclip is finishing agent setup.
verify.rejected: The routine rejected delivery. Check its URL and key, then try again.
verify.accepted: The routine accepted delivery. Waiting for an authenticated reply to Paperclip.
verify.sendChallenge: Send a harmless challenge. This creates no task.
verify.external: Grok runs externally. Usage and spending are not reported. Paperclip contact does not prove the Bot is continuously available.
